:::: {.hero}
# About

::: {.stand}
Notknowing Garden is run by two practitioners, [FG](fg.qmd) and [DS](ds.qmd).
We create spaces together, online and in person, that combine tantra and yoga, and
we write about what the research says about the body.
:::
::::

::: {.band .band-about}
:::

## What we do

::: {.ways}

::: {.way}
[Gatherings]{.k}

We create spaces to practise and learn together, online and in person. The
first ones coming up are two retreats in 2027: one for practitioners who want
to lead groups, and one movement retreat for anyone.

[see what is coming up →](../community/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.way}
[Writing]{.k}

We write long reading guides to the research on touch, pain and breathing.

[read the writing →](../writing/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.way}
[A podcast]{.k}

The podcast will be a series of conversations with people who work with the
body. There are no episodes yet.

[about the podcast →](../podcast/index.qmd)
:::

:::

## The name

Much of what is taught about the body is less certain than it sounds. We would
rather start from a question than from a fixed answer, in a room and on the
page. Notknowing Garden is a place to grow from there.

## Write to us {#write-to-us}

::: {.ask}
We welcome questions, ideas, or just a hello, about the gatherings, the
